_comment: Real-stack end-to-end smoke workflow. POST this to /api/v1/workflows on a running CP that has the worker-executor (:8004) + an http_request worker registered. Then POST /api/v1/runs {workflow_id}. The TASK node dispatches to the real http_request worker, which performs an actual HTTP GET; the response (status_code/response_body/...) flows back into the node output and the run reaches COMPLETED.
name: claude-real-e2e-http
description: real e2e: TASK runs the http_request worker against a live HTTP endpoint
